name: pam_duress
description: Alternate password for emergency data clearing
detailed_description: Allows users to provide an alternate 'duress' password that can be used to trigger emergency actions such as clearing sensitive data, notifying security staff, or closing sensitive network connections if coerced. Provides emergency access mechanisms without compromising security.

parameters.duress_user: User to authenticate as when duress password is used
parameters.emergency_contacts: Contacts to notify on duress trigger

notes:
Provides emergency access and data protection mechanisms. Requires careful configuration of duress actions.
